mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the judgement of conscience before the course of action has been taken."
Antecedent conscience is the judgement of conscience before the course of action has been taken.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one that is informed and guided by social condition, education as well as family ties."
Natural conscience is the one that is informed and guided by social condition, education as well as family ties.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same thing as civil law."
Common Law and Equity Common law is the same thing as civil law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the law that regulates the relationship between individuals."
Private law refers to the law that regulates the relationship between individuals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means total obedience to a powerful authority."
Morality in the African context means total obedience to a powerful authority.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the same thing as the principles of morality, the moral law or the natural law or the law of God."
Moral Law Moral law to some people is the same thing as the principles of morality, the moral law or the natural law or the law of God.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to fundamental belief of a religion like Trinity for Christianity, and Five pillars of Islam."
Creed refers to fundamental belief of a religion like Trinity for Christianity, and Five pillars of Islam.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the methods of moral teaching and learning religious education."
Dramatization is one of the methods of moral teaching and learning religious education.
fib: ______ means a state law: a law operating internally within a country while international law refers to the rule and morals that regulate the relationship between the nations of the world.
Municipal law
Municipal law means a state law: a law operating internally within a country while international law refers to the rule and morals that regulate the relationship between the nations of the world.
______ is a place where relevant information concerning religions or education generally can be gathered.
resource centre
A resource centre is a place where relevant information concerning religions or education generally can be gathered.
______ are the same throughout the whole world.
Moral rules
Moral rules are the same throughout the whole world.
______ is a conscientious being; his conscience reveals to him what decision to make or the course of action to take.
Man
Man is a conscientious being; his conscience reveals to him what decision to make or the course of action to take.
______ is one of the effects of globalisation.
change in values
The change in values is one of the effects of globalisation.

Globalisation
Globalisation is the construction of the oneness of the world, thus a move towards global unit in all aspects of human life.
______ refers to the law that governs the relationship between individuals and the state government.
Public law
Public law refers to the law that governs the relationship between individuals and the state government.
______ refers to the law which defines the rights and duties of individuals.
Civil law
Civil law refers to the law which defines the rights and duties of individuals.
